WELLTYPE: Unknown--well type or information missing may not be drilled
WELLTYPE.2RSI: UIC Simultaneous Injection well--also produces oil and/or gas to surface
WELLTYPE.NT: No type--unknown old well likely without a completion report and/or other documents
WELLTYPE.OBS: Obervation well for Gas Storage facility
WELLTYPE.ORPH: Legacy Orphaned well--wellstatus now used to capture this
WELLTYPE.P&A: Legacy plugged and abandoned well--wellstatus now used to capture this
WELLTYPE.PA: Legacy plugged and abandoned well--wellstatus now used to capture this
WELLTYPE.STFD: Legacy State Funds well--wellstatus now used to capture this
WELLTYPE.SW: Service Well--used for pressure maintenance-stratigraphic test holes-etc
WELLTYPE.TA: Legacy temporarily abandoned well--wellstatus now used to capture this
WELLTYPE.TM: Terminated UIC well--voluntary or mandatory revocation of UIC authorization
WELLTYPE.WSW: Water Supply Well--water well used for variety of purposes | may not be fresh

WELLSTATUS: Unknown--Mostly new wells or wells without a completion report
WELLSTATUS.ACRT: Active--UIC open wellbores which have been red tagged b/c of compliance issues
WELLSTATUS.DUC: Wells drilled to TD but not completed
WELLSTATUS.EX: Expired Permit--expired prior to drilling operations
WELLSTATUS.ND: New Drill--newly drilled wells | often missing completion report
WELLSTATUS.NE: No Evidence--Field Inspectors have investigated and did not find a well at the location reported | unclear if plugged or location was innacurate
WELLSTATUS.OR: Orphaned Wells--wells with no known or viable Operator
WELLSTATUS.PA: Plugged and Abandoned--wells which have a plugging report or were plugged before records were kept
WELLSTATUS.PAFF: Plugged and Abandoned--wells plugged with Federal Funds
WELLSTATUS.PASF: Plugged and Abandoned--wells plugged with State Funds
WELLSTATUS.PASUR: Plugged and Abandoned--wells plugged with Surety Funds
WELLSTATUS.PASURSF: Plugged and Abandoned--wells plugged with Surety and State Funds
WELLSTATUS.SIFORDER: Wells shut in by Final Order
WELLSTATUS.SP: Spudded Wells--wells with a spud report but no completion report | probably drilled out
WELLSTATUS.STFD: State Fund--wells on list to be plugged with State Funds
WELLSTATUS.TA: Temporarily Abandoned--wells not plugged but inactive
WELLSTATUS.TM: Terminated--legacy status used for UIC wells which had authorization revoked currently not plugged
